still_usable_note: Official documentation describes REST Admin API as legacy and continues to publish versioned REST references while directing new app development to GraphQL Admin API.
summary: Shopify REST Admin API is a legacy commerce API surface with migration guidance to GraphQL Admin API.
current_state: Legacy API surface according to current official documentation; no universal REST removal deadline is recorded in this canonical record.
known_unknowns: The record tracks REST Admin API legacy status and migration guidance, not complete removal of every REST surface.
April 1, 2025 is an applicability date for new public apps, not a universal removal deadline for all existing REST integrations.
notes: Stage 7 first-party follow-up corrected the earlier over-broad treatment of April 1, 2025 as a universal migration deadline.
